### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in both methods of the `TestS3AConfiguration.java` file indicate a shift in how exceptions are handled when testing proxy connections. Previously, the tests raised an exception if the error message did not match specific conditions. The new implementation simplifies the tests by assuming that an `AmazonClientException` is expected in both cases, regardless of the specific error message content. This change likely addresses failures caused by changes in the behavior of the HTTP client library after the upgrade, allowing the tests to pass without being overly stringent on the error message details.
